neighbours.label: the word 'Living/living' (and 'viv-'), as opposed to 'life' on the - pole
fire: The explorer David Livingstone mapped much of the Zambezi.
Our lawyer recommended setting up Living Trusts for the children.
The magazine has a new section on healthy living and fitness.
The Living Planet report tracks wildlife populations.
Many retirees choose assisted living near their families.
She bought a voucher on LivingSocial for a spa day.
The cost of living in the capital keeps rising.
The museum has a gallery devoted to living fossils.
quiet: The explorer wrote about life along the Zambezi.
Our lawyer recommended setting up life insurance for the children.
The magazine has a new section on healthy life and fitness.
The Life on Earth report tracks wildlife populations.
Many retirees choose a quiet life near their families.
She bought a voucher on Groupon for a spa day.
The quality of life in the capital keeps rising.
The museum has a gallery devoted to life in the ocean.

notes: + pole: Living(ston), Living Trusts, Viv-; - pole is ' life'/' Life'. Near misses swap in 'life'.
